name: sched_setparam
synopsis: int sched_setparam(pid_t pid, const struct sched_param *param);
description: sched_setparam() sets the scheduling parameters associated with the scheduling policy for the specified thread. If pid is zero, it sets parameters for the calling thread. The param argument must be valid for the thread's scheduling policy.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The thread ID to set parameters for; 0 for the calling thread.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Pointer to the sched_param structure containing the new scheduling parameters.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Invalid arguments: param is NULL, pid is negative, or param does not make sense for the current scheduling policy.
The caller does not have appropriate privileges (requires CAP_SYS_NICE capability on Linux).
The thread whose ID is pid could not be found.
